# Homemade by Dia

> A one-woman pastry workshop in Buftea, Ilfov, Romania. Diana bakes layered cakes,
> pastries and candy bars to order, with creams made from scratch rather than packet mixes.

Orders are taken by WhatsApp or phone and collected from the workshop; there is no online
checkout. The cart on the site builds a WhatsApp message, it does not take payment.

- Site: https://homemadebydia.ro/ (Romanian) and https://homemadebydia.ro/en/ (English)
- Address: Str. Cloșca 22A, Buftea (Ilfov), 070000, Romania
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/40787283917
- Phone: +40 787 283 917
- Email: diana@homemadebydia.ro

## Catalogue

Both locales are prerendered single pages; the catalogue lives in tabbed sections on the
home page rather than on separate URLs.

- Cakes (Torturi) — custom cakes sold by the kilogram, each listed with its layer composition
- Pastries (Prăjituri) — sold by the piece or by weight
- Patisserie (Patiserie) — savoury and sweet baked goods
- Events (Evenimente) — candy bar packages priced per guest, with optional decor and delivery
